short_description:
How to skip time in GTA 6: go to any safehouse you've unlocked, use the bed and pick when you want to wake up. The clock jumps straight there: handy for night jobs or a sunset drive. Tip from the guides: make a manual save after you wake up. Taxis can take you home if you're far away. No story spoilers.

Sources: KeenGamer, Video Games Chronicle, PowerPyx, TalkEsport.

More GTA 6 how-tos at vicereplay.com (Guides).
